name: lkep_ctrl_phy_ref-ctrlphy1-COMMIT
purpose: Extract all remaining link parent own state into one own-clock controller/PHY hard leaf. Register per-SUB CRC-qualified valid on original capture edge, preserve packet/credit/reset/relay epochs against immutable full-core golden. Reuse former core clock entry; parent has zero own flops and sixteen total clock entries. This 216um square M5 window is an UNASSIGNED prototype until actual native parent pin and clock contract binding; no die fit claim.
